transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02. The deletion removed about 17,500 lines and 113 test files, in PR #2431. The external Floor replaced it. That is the standalone rewrite, re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`. Per ADR-049, the move happened one family of assembly lines at a time, with both floors running side by side until the last line had moved. The old line files and the fallbacks to the deleted engine were then removed in PR #2454.
